title: A2 seen-regression semantic consistency audit

reviewer.priorContext: Reviewer previously reviewed V5 methods/data/writer artifacts. This audit saw V9 arms, sources and gold.
reviewer.incidentalOutOfScopeRead: During initial schema inspection, context/result for new-development case c9b7bb3d1803 was opened once. It is excluded from all annotations and counts; subsequent case reads were restricted to the 24 seen-regression IDs.

scope.targetOnly: Consistency concerns answer and the requested final target memory value/status/text, not all stale non-target memories.

method.semanticJudgments: AI reviewer actually read all 72 answers, final target text/value/status and each case visible original sources and input memories. Labels and case-specific explanations were manually specified by the AI after reading, not inferred by regex or answer keyword matching. Script only packages copied records, verifies field comparisons and aggregates annotations.
method.consistent: Explicit or clearly implied final target value and certainty in answer agree with committed final target. This does not imply correctness against evidence.
method.conflict: Answer declares a target value or certainty incompatible with the committed target.
method.unclear: Answer does not support a clear comparison or usable answer/final state is absent.
method.correctnessSeparate: Evidence correctness is independently recorded for prose, committed value and committed status. Arithmetic errors in explanation and incorrect uncertainty are retained even when final consistency is satisfied.
method.review: Review shares original candidate. Accepted review with retained erroneous status is not counted as complete repair. No fallback occurred among these 24 review records.
method.independence: Seen cases and repeated role/family variants are not independent samples; no statistical or generalization claim.

findings: Original has 4 answer/commit conflicts: three pure correct-prose/wrong-value rule-revision cases, plus one unknown-invariant case whose prose also wrongly demands uncertainty.
Review removes those value conflicts but leaves unknown-invariant report true/uncertain: semantically aligned with its retained answer, still wrong against evidence.
Answer-first has no answer/commit conflicts and all 24 target values/statuses are correct, but one joint-unknown explanation contains a wrong product (4×3 reported as15 rather than12).
All 72 have correct prose target-value conclusions; this must not be conflated with entirely correct prose: 2 retain wrong uncertainty and 1 has an arithmetic error.
No unclear records or review fallbacks in this split. This is an AI subagent audit, not human validation or automated formal entailment proof.
